tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one drug or therapy program by its name or any code name (ubx1325, UBX-1325, BMS-986278). Returns its developers, partners and licensors, targets, mechanism, modality, every indication with its stage and source, lifespan evidence and news; its published research (pa

tools.name: count_pipeline
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many drug and therapy programs there are, or how a field's pipeline splits. Counts programs grouped by stage, modality, target, hallmark, indication, the developer's country or the developer, with each group's count at each stage. Takes list_assets' filters: by=target

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to follow a drug, gene, process, disease or other entity on AgingResearch.News, so its new papers reach them. Takes the type and key that find_entities or get_entity give. Following is saved to the user's account: new papers on it appear in For you and the daily follow em

tools.name: unfollow
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to stop following a drug, gene, process or other entity on AgingResearch.News. Takes the type and key that list_follows, find_entities or get_entity give. Removes the follow from the user's account.

tools.name: list_follows
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what they follow on AgingResearch.News. Lists the drugs, genes, processes and saved searches their account follows, newest first, each with its page; an entity's id is the type:key that unfollow takes.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about questions they asked AgingResearch.News (Ask) before. Lists their most recent conversations, newest first, each with its title and its address, where the answer and its sources are.

tools.name: open_arn
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to open AgingResearch.News or to see their feed, follows and recent questions in one place. Shows the newest stories (For you when the user is signed in, else Top), what they follow and their recent questions, with search.

tools.name: list_feed
tools.description: Only for the AgingResearch.News sidebar app: returns the reader's For you or Top feed as story cards for the sidebar to show. To answer what is new in aging research, use list_stories or list_papers.

tools.name: search_arn
tools.description: Only for the AgingResearch.News sidebar app: the sidebar search box's results, the topics a query names (to open or follow) and the papers that match it most closely, as cards. To answer a research question, use search_papers; to find a drug, gene or topic, use find_entities.

tools.name: ask_arn
tools.description: Use this when the user asks a research question on the biology of aging, longevity interventions, age-related disease, or the people and companies of the field (for example: does rapamycin extend lifespan in people, what is known about senolytics for frailty, who works on epigenetic clocks). Not for

tools.name: start_ultradeep
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a full review of the evidence on a research question in aging or longevity, beyond a short answer. Not for personal medical advice, doses or symptoms. It writes, over several minutes, a review in five sections: the bottom line, the evidence by kind of study, contradic

tools.name: get_ask_answer
tools.description: Use this when ask_arn or start_ultradeep said an answer is still being written, or the user wants it again: it reads that question's answer by the question_id they gave: the answer with its numbered sources once it is written, or where it stands while it is written. Waits up to 20 seconds for a shor

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_arn, list_feed, get_ask_answer · Private data: search_papers, get_trial, list_grants, list_assets, get_asset, count_pipeline, ask_arn · Public sink: follow · Destructive: list_trials, get_conference.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_arn, list_feed, get_ask_answer · Private data: search_papers, get_trial, list_grants, list_assets, get_asset, count_pipeline, ask_arn · Public sink: follow · Destructive: list_trials, get_conference

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
